        """
        Run the crawler asynchronously.

        This method is similar to :meth:`crawl` but is designed to be used
        with async/await syntax. It returns when the crawling is complete.

        :param args: arguments to initialize the spider
        :param kwargs: keyword arguments to initialize the spider
        """
        if self.crawling:
            raise RuntimeError("Crawling already taking place")
        if self._started:

            )

class AsyncCrawlerProcess(CrawlerProcess):
    """
    A class to run multiple scrapy crawlers in a process simultaneously using async/await.

    This class extends :class:`~scrapy.crawler.CrawlerProcess` by providing
    async/await support for running crawlers. It requires
    :class:`~twisted.internet.asyncioreactor.AsyncioSelectorReactor`.

    This utility should be a better fit than
    :class:`~scrapy.crawler.CrawlerProcess` if you are using async/await syntax
    and want to run crawlers asynchronously.

    The AsyncCrawlerProcess object must be instantiated with a
    :class:`~scrapy.settings.Settings` object.

    :param install_root_handler: whether to install root logging handler
        (default: True)

    This class shouldn't be needed (since Scrapy is responsible of using it
    accordingly) unless writing scripts that manually handle the crawling
    process. See :ref:`run-from-script` for an example.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: dict[str, Any] | Settings | None = None,
        install_root_handler: bool = True,
    ):
        super().__init__(settings, install_root_handler)

    async def start(self, stop_after_crawl: bool = True) -> None:
        """
        This method starts a :mod:`~twisted.internet.reactor`, adjusts its pool
        size to :setting:`REACTOR_THREADPOOL_MAXSIZE`, and installs a DNS cache
        based on :setting:`DNSCACHE_ENABLED` and :setting:`DNSCACHE_SIZE`.

        If ``stop_after_crawl`` is True, the reactor will be stopped after all
        crawlers have finished, using :meth:`join`.

        :param bool stop_after_crawl: stop or not the reactor when all
            crawlers have finished
        """
        from twisted.internet import reactor

        if not is_asyncio_reactor_installed():
            raise RuntimeError("AsyncCrawlerProcess requires AsyncioSelectorReactor.")

        if stop_after_crawl:
            await self.join()

        resolver_class = load_object(self.settings["DNS_RESOLVER"])
        # We pass self, which is AsyncCrawlerProcess, instead of Crawler here,
        # which works because the default resolvers only use crawler.settings.
        resolver = build_from_crawler(resolver_class, self, reactor=reactor)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        resolver.install_on_reactor()
        tp = reactor.getThreadPool()
        tp.adjustPoolsize(maxthreads=self.settings.getint("REACTOR_THREADPOOL_MAXSIZE"))
        reactor.addSystemEventTrigger("before", "shutdown", self.stop)

    A class to run multiple scrapy crawlers in a process simultaneously using async/await.

    This class extends :class:`~scrapy.crawler.CrawlerProcess` by providing
    async/await support for running crawlers. It requires
    :class:`~twisted.internet.asyncioreactor.AsyncioSelectorReactor`.

    This class shouldn't be needed (since Scrapy is responsible of using it
    accordingly) unless writing scripts that manually handle the crawling
    process. See :ref:`run-from-script` for an example.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: dict[str, Any] | Settings | None = None,
        install_root_handler: bool = True,
    ):
        super().__init__(settings, install_root_handler)

    async def start(self, stop_after_crawl: bool = True) -> None:
        """
        This method starts a :mod:`~twisted.internet.reactor`, adjusts its pool
        size to :setting:`REACTOR_THREADPOOL_MAXSIZE`, and installs a DNS cache
        based on :setting:`DNSCACHE_ENABLED` and :setting:`DNSCACHE_SIZE`.

        If ``stop_after_crawl`` is True, the reactor will be stopped after all
        crawlers have finished, using :meth:`join`.

        :param bool stop_after_crawl: stop or not the reactor when all
            crawlers have finished
        """
        from twisted.internet import reactor

        if not is_asyncio_reactor_installed():
            raise RuntimeError("AsyncCrawlerProcess requires AsyncioSelectorReactor.")

        if stop_after_crawl:
            await self.join()

        resolver_class = load_object(self.settings["DNS_RESOLVER"])
        resolver = build_from_crawler(resolver_class, self, reactor=reactor)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        resolver.install_on_reactor()
        tp = reactor.getThreadPool()
        tp.adjustPoolsize(maxthreads=self.settings.getint("REACTOR_THREADPOOL_MAXSIZE"))
        reactor.addSystemEventTrigger("before", "shutdown", self.stop)
        reactor.run(installSignalHandlers=False)

    async def _graceful_stop_reactor(self) -> None:
        await self.stop()
        self._stop_reactor()
